name: PlantRule
lead: A plant on a column. Each column takes at most one: a rule that holds is tried with its `chance` (1), in the order of the list.

fields.name: blocks
fields.description: The blocks from the foot up, in place of `block`: a two-block flower.

fields.name: tip
fields.description: With `height`, the block on top of a plant that grows.

fields.name: height
fields.description: How many blocks a plant that grows is tall: `block` repeats.

fields.name: afloat
fields.description: On the water over a column, not on its ground.

fields.name: sink
fields.description: Blocks to stand lower: 1 is in the ground, or in the top of the water.

fields.name: clear
fields.description: Blocks of water to keep clear over a plant that grows in it.

fields.name: place
fields.description: Where it goes: "top" (the default), or in the caves `density` or `carvers` dig: "floor", "ceiling" (it hangs down: `tip` is lowest) or "wall" (one block; `{wall}` in its name is the side the rock is on, `{facing}` the side away). One plant on each floor and each ceiling of a cave, and in each wall block. `when` and `chance` are read at the air block it starts in.

fields.name: y
fields.description: `{ low, high }`: the y it may start at.
